brief.summary: Equities are slightly firmer near records, but the dominant cross-asset move is higher Treasury yields: two-year, 10-year and 30-year yields are at multi-decade highs and the curve has steepened. Oil is lower on supply relief, credit spreads are slightly wider, and the dollar and gold were not discussed. The Fed is hawkish; markets price a high probability of an October hike and further tightening. The show’s narrative is a bond-vigilante selloff driven by war, deficits, data and Fed hikes, with worry about negative feedback loops. Tone is cautious and net risk-off despite resilient equity futures.
notable_quotes: This might be the revenge of the bond vigilantes.
It seems like one of them has to give in order to durably materially reduce yields.
